message: Thanks for reaching out. I'll ask a few quick questions to see what your household may qualify for. First: which state do you live in?
Thanks. Roughly how much does your household earn from work in a year, before tax?
Got it, no earned income. How many children under 18 live with you?
Thanks. Do you receive any other income in a year, such as unemployment, pensions, child support, or interest? And roughly how much is in your bank accounts and investments?
Thanks. Last check: is anyone in the household a full-time college student?

summary: Single adult household in Alabama, age 30s, healthy, no children, no earned or other income, about $1,900 in assets, not a college student. Recommended: SNAP, since zero income and low assets fit its limits. Not recommended: Medicaid (Alabama has not expanded it, and non-disabled adults without children do not qualify), SSI (no age 65+ or disability), TANF, WIC, CHIP, school meals, CTC and EITC (no children or earned income), ACA premium tax credit (no income to qualify for the subsidy). Note: as an able-bodied adult without dependents, SNAP time limits may apply (3 months in 36 unless working or in a work program), so the household should check that when applying.
